permission_evidence: Limited local exploratory research on public deidentified measurements, supported by the investigators data-sharing statement at https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/oby.22389 (Acknowledgments: any purpose by anyone), the public author-controlled OSF file https://osf.io/ztysq/, and the user request to perform the evaluation. This is a scoped research-use interpretation, not a finding that the full file has a formal license. OSF currently states No License. Scope of a blanket license for all 609 participants, commercial use, redistribution and production deployment is not resolved or claimed. Raw records and trained coefficients are not redistributed in the delivery.
reviewed_by: Codex: documented source and scope review for this local research run
